checks: The Schengen Borders Code requires covered short-stay travelers to substantiate the purpose and conditions of the stay and have sufficient means. Annex I gives examples of supporting documents border officers may request.
Schengen external border; covered third-country short stays
Check current national amounts, exemptions, sponsorship and acceptable documents. A mandatory advance form is a separate question.

For travelers in scope, EES records each departure at the external border. Previous enrollment may allow verification against existing data, and border officers can collect data again where necessary.
EES external crossings; covered non-EU short-stay travelers
Check exemptions and route. Domestic or intra-Schengen movement and destination export rules require separate review.
Unless exempted, persons entering for a visit or work require the applicable electronic entry permit. Applications may be made by travelers or an authorized intermediary.
South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands, entry permit
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Check deemed permission, latest fees, entry period, and itinerary or vessel process. Falkland transit is separate.
The territory asks commercial and private vessel operators to submit a booking notification. The operator process is distinct from individual permit applications.
Vessel visits to South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Check current vessel class, arrival paperwork and operator responsibility.
The government gives cleaning and inspection instructions for vessels, baggage and outdoor gear to prevent introducing non-native species.
Territorial biosecurity; landing and vessel visits
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Check current forms, food and equipment restrictions by landing and operator.
Visitors must follow the territory's Visitor Code of Conduct while ashore.
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Check current code and site-specific directions before landing.
Visitor landings are limited to authorized sites and conditions. Specially protected areas can have separate restrictions.
South Georgia protected visitor sites and landings
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Confirm site openings, permit conditions and season with the government and operator.
Drone use can require a Regulated Activity Permit under the territory's protected-area and wildlife framework.
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Check purpose, location and current guidance before any operation. Drone import is separate.
Government permit guidance includes sample collection among potentially prohibited regulated activities.
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Check whether the exact item, location and purpose require authorization.
Some media filming requiring close approach to wildlife can trigger regulated-activity controls.
South Georgia and South Sandwich Islands wildlife-related filming
Government of South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Personal photography, media access and drone operation require distinct scope checks.
Eligible visitors staying no more than 14 days and returning on the same vessel can apply for a short-term visitor visa on arrival.
Check current eligibility, passport requirements, longer visits and different vessel plans.
On-arrival short-term visitor applications use a combined immigration and biosecurity declaration.
Pitcairn Island; eligible short-term visitor visas
Confirm carrier instructions, supporting documents and current entry process.
The immigration authority lists health and travel and medical insurance conditions for short-term visitors, with possible waivers by the Governor.
Verify policy wording, cover thresholds, evacuation and exemptions for the trip.
Saint Helena publishes a Short Term Entry Permit process that includes specific passport validity conditions.
Saint Helena Island only within ISO SH
Check nationality, route and duration, and the separate regimes of Ascension and Tristan da Cunha.
The Short Term Entry Permit requirements include medical insurance covering emergency medical needs.
Saint Helena Island; Short Term Entry Permit
Confirm coverage threshold, exceptions and long-term entry categories.
Port Control lists honey, fresh produce and plant material as prohibited from landing.
Saint Helena Island; port and vessel guidance
Verify air baggage guidance and any official exceptions separately.
The Ascension Island Government requires an entry permit visa unless an exemption applies.
Check occupation or status exemptions, travel route, entry duration and permit type.
The government requires proof of adequate travel and medical insurance for the stay.
Check medical evacuation coverage and current supporting-document requirements.
Covered imports must meet item-specific health standards. Incoming vessels and aircraft have declaration duties for covered arrivals.
Ascension Island biosecurity; operator and import requirements
Check item-level passenger rules and documentation. An operator declaration is not passenger clearance.
The UK travel advisory distinguishes Tristan da Cunha's entry process from Saint Helena and Ascension and refers visitors to local authorities.
UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
Confirm landing permission and exemptions with the island administration.
Visiting-vessel biosecurity guidance calls for cleaning and a self-audit declaration before landing and provides for spot checks.
Tristan da Cunha and permitted outer-island landings under local vessel guidance
Check latest arrival procedure, permitted sites and item-specific rules.
Norway does not require a visa to enter Svalbard itself. A traveler who needs a Schengen visa must check the mainland route and re-entry permission.
Svalbard portion of ISO SJ; mainland Norway transit is distinct
Does not apply to Jan Mayen. Confirm passport or ID rules and the actual transit itinerary.
The Governor publishes trip notification and permission requirements and distinguishes organized tours from independent travel.
Svalbard field travel only within ISO SJ
Check travel area, operators, activities and deadlines. Jan Mayen is separate.
The Governor reports that amendments effective 1 January 2025 prohibited drone use in protected areas covered by the Svalbard rules.
Check the exact protected area, permit exceptions and drone rules elsewhere.
Arrivals must present a passport or other accepted evidence of identity and nationality or permanent residence for inspection.
Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control
Check nationality, route and which alternative documents are accepted.
A border officer may ask visitors to demonstrate sufficient funds for their stay and dependants.
Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control
Confirm applicable forms and onward travel requirements separately.
The Department of Agriculture says fresh fruits and vegetables require a permit regardless of quantity.
Cayman Islands personal imports of fresh produce
Check product, country of origin and special permissions before travel.
The Department of Agriculture regulates live pets and requires import approval before bringing a pet from overseas.
Cayman Islands Customs and Border Control
Confirm species, breed, country of origin, health documents and travel dates.
Bermuda Customs generally allows reasonable quantities of prescribed medicine for personal use without listing them on Customs Form 98.
Verify substance-specific permit and controlled-drug rules separately.
Bermuda Customs requires departing travelers to declare precious metals and stones when their combined value exceeds BDA 10,000 or its equivalent.
Bermuda departures; new customs traveler declaration
Check current form and separately review currency rules on precleared routes.
Bermuda publishes reporting thresholds and forms for accompanied cash and negotiable instruments, including a separate procedure for US-precleared departures.
Bermuda customs, arrival or departure as applicable
Determine accompanied personal versus other cash, direction and US preclearance exemptions or dual reporting.
The government identifies a prior import permit and health certificate among the documents for animal arrivals.
Confirm species, breed, origin, microchip, vaccination and current validity periods.
Visitor permit guidance asks for onward travel arrangements or funds to purchase onward travel and lists other supporting documents.
Falkland Islands Customs and Immigration Service
Confirm cruise, temporary landing and other exemptions and separate any transit requirements.
Visitor permit guidance requires adequate medical insurance covering aeromedical evacuation.
Falkland Islands Customs and Immigration Service
Confirm exact coverage and traveler class, and separately check vaccinations and transit requirements.
Employment is prohibited on a visitor permit, with exceptions for certain specified business activities under immigration law.
Falkland Islands Customs and Immigration Service
Check activity, time limit and any authorization with the Immigration Service.
The UK travel advisory flags consequences for unauthorized photography at the Mount Pleasant military site.
UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office
Check primary local rule and site authorization. No island-wide inference.
Jersey publishes separate ETA eligibility and document guidance, with ETA potentially required from 23 April 2026.
Jersey immigration; route, nationality and status dependent
Check the Common Travel Area route, visa or settlement status, nationality and any ferry or carrier documentation.
Jersey Customs may ask entering or departing travelers to disclose cash carried. The authority describes a voluntary advance disclosure for amounts over EUR 10,000 or equivalent.
Government of Jersey, Customs and Immigration Service
Confirm scope of cash and instruments and other jurisdictions on the itinerary. Voluntary advance disclosure and answers to officials are distinct.
The government distinguishes travel with dogs, cats and ferrets from within the UK and Islands from other origins and identifies different document procedures.
Jersey animal movements for specified pets and origins
Verify disease controls, carrier acceptance, and travel from outside these origins.
Jersey restricts some personal food and animal products based on origin and has specified exceptions.
Jersey food and animal products in passenger luggage
Check item, quantity, temporary controls and other plant or equipment requirements.
